packageRules.description: Everything non-major goes in one PR and merges itself. These are small, frequent and reversible by putting the old tag back.

Majors get their own PR and are never merged automatically. A database major cannot be done by swapping the tag -- PostgreSQL refuses to start on a data directory written by another major, so the data has to be dumped and restored first. Grouping majors with patches (separateMajorMinor: false) once put postgres 17 -> 18 in the same automerged PR as an nginx patch.
